name: token-safety-check
description: Rug check tokens on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Solana: a 0-100 risk score with plain reasons.
long_description: Two tools. check_token_safety returns a 0-100 risk score with plain-language reasons (mint, freeze, blacklist, fee or pause powers, upgradeable code, holder concentration, thin liquidity, a deployer whose earlier tokens lost their liquidity), the facts behind it, and USD price and liquidity. watch_tokens re-checks up to 5 tokens in one call and, given earlier fingerprints, reports what changed with one-line alerts. Each call costs $0.01 in USDC on Base, paid from your own wallet through x402, with a per-call spending cap.

tools.name: check_token_safety
tools.description: Rug check a token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana: 0-100 risk score with reasons, price and liquidity. $0.01 in USDC on Base per check.

tools.name: watch_tokens
tools.description: Re-check up to 5 tokens in one call: score, level, price, liquidity and fingerprint each; with earlier fingerprints, what changed plus alerts. $0.01 in USDC on Base per call.

x402_private_key.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet holding a little USDC on Base. It pays $0.01 per check; don't use your main wallet.
